conventions.time_scale: the civil time is converted to UTC with the IANA tz database (engine.tzdb_version); UT1 is taken EQUAL to UTC (DUT1 ignored, |DUT1| < 0.9 s - with the real UT1 the ascendant can move by tens of arcseconds); TT = UT + the engine's delta T
conventions.angles: degrees in [0, 360) rounded to 4 decimals; the DMS strings of the answer are derived from these numbers; the Ascendant is the ecliptic point rising on the EASTERN horizon (swe.houses), which above the polar circle can be the point opposite to the textbook atan2 formula without quadrant correction
conventions.house_system: Placidus; Whole Sign (Whole_Sign_Polar_Fallback) where Placidus is undefined
conventions.sunrise: Swiss Ephemeris rise_trans, upper limb of the disc, refraction on with atpress=0, attemp=0 (Swiss Ephemeris standard 1013.25 hPa, 15 C), observer at 0 m
conventions.planetary_hours: with coordinates: the planetary day runs from a local sunrise to the next one, 12 equal day hours and 12 equal night hours, Chaldean order (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon); the first hour is ruled by the planet of the weekday of that sunrise's civil date in the request's zone (no zone: the local-mean-time date of the solar noon of that arc); without coordinates or under polar circumpolar fallback: 24 equal hours from 06:00 UTC
conventions.elements: Fire: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius; Earth: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn; Air: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius; Water: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces
conventions.mayan_dresden: Classic Mayan Dresden Codex GMT 584283 correlation on the civil date (20 K'iche' Cholq'ij Nawals and 13 Galactic Tones)
conventions.vedic_lahiri: Sidereal Moon longitude under the Lahiri Chitrapaksha Ayanamsa (swe.SIDM_LAHIRI) mapped to the 27 equal 13°20' Janma Nakshatras
conventions.taoist_bazi: Sexagenary Day Pillar (Ganzhi) Heavenly Stem mapped to the 5 Wu Xing elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water)
conventions.human_design_iching: Tropical Sun ecliptic longitude mapped to the 64 Rave Mandala / I-Ching hexagram gates and 6 lines (each gate spans 5°37'30", each line 0°56'15")
conventions.pythagorean_life_path: Digital root reduction of YYYY+MM+DD preserving Master Numbers 11, 22, 33
conventions.kabbalah_shem: 72 Shem HaMephorash angels mapped in 5-degree quinaries around the 360° tropical zodiac from 0° Aries (#1..#72), using the tropical Sun of the exact birth instant (since 1.1.0; 1.0.0 used the Sun of 12:00 UTC of the civil date)
conventions.vvk_rings: Ring I (vvk_cosmic_key VVK-XXXX-YYYY) is deterministic from the civil date's 12:00 UTC solar longitude, Mayan Kin, and Golden Ratio; Ring II (vvk_spacetime_key VVK-XXXX-YYYY-ZZZZ) adds the exact birth instant and coordinates
conventions.isolation: the calculation API carries no word of the Talking Circle (Agora v2, 2026-10-31)
conventions.invalid_input: a birth_date that is not a valid ISO calendar date is refused with HTTP 400 and nothing is calculated
